aiOverview.content: The Illinois Fighting Illini (University of Illinois) athletics, a Big Ten member, features extensive sports, with top-tier men's/women's basketball and football. The 2025 football team finished 9-4, winning the Liberty Mutual Music City Bowl 30-28. Men's basketball is currently having a strong 2025-26 season (20-4 overall) and has reached the Final Four. Key 2025-26 Season Highlights & Schedule Football (9-4): Won vs. W. Illinois (52-3), Duke (45-19), W. Michigan (38-0), USC (34-32), Purdue (43-27), Rutgers (35-13), Maryland (24-6), Northwestern (20-13). Lost to Indiana (10-63), Ohio State (16-34), Washington (25-42), Wisconsin (10-27). Bowl Game: Won Liberty Mutual Music City Bowl vs. Tennessee 30-28. Men’s Basketball (20-4): Key Wins: Texas Tech (81-77), Colgate (84-65), Tennessee (75-62), Missouri (91-48), Rutgers (81-55). Key Losses: Alabama (86-90), Nebraska (80-83). Upcoming: 2026 Final Four appearance. Upcoming Events & Information Check the full 2025 Football Schedule and Men's Basketball Schedule on the official athletics site. 2025 Football Schedule Men's Basketball Schedule official athletics site The Busey Bank Illini Sports Network offers live/archived events, podcasts, and photo galleries. Busey Bank Illini Sports Network Other sports with active schedules include women's volleyball, soccer, softball, baseball, swimming, diving, and tennis.
